points.title: 童年时光
points.description: 让·拉辛1639年12月22日出生于法国拉费泰-米隆的一个小资产阶级家庭。他的父亲让·拉辛是当地的一名官员，母亲让娜·萨西是富商之女。不幸的是，拉辛四岁时父亲去世，母亲随后也离开了他。拉辛由外祖母和姑母抚养长大，这段童年经历对他后来的性格和创作产生了深远影响，使他过早地接触到了生活的艰辛和人际关系的复杂性。
points.descriptionEn: Jean Racine was born on December 22, 1639, in La Ferté-Milon, France, into a middle-class family. His father, also named Jean Racine, was a local official, and his mother, Jeanne Sassine, came from a wealthy merchant family. Tragically, Racine lost his father at the age of four, and his mother subsequently left him. Raised by his grandmother and aunt, these early childhood experiences profoundly influenced his character and later works, exposing him prematurely to life's hardships and the complexities of human relationships.

points.title: 求学时期
points.description: 1649年，拉辛被送往波城的一所耶稣会学校接受教育。在这里，他接受了严格的古典教育，学习了拉丁语、希腊语和古典文学。这段教育经历为他后来的戏剧创作奠定了坚实的古典文学基础。1655年，他转入鲁昂的耶稣会学校，继续深造。在鲁昂期间，他开始尝试写作诗歌，并展现出非凡的文学才华。这段求学经历不仅塑造了他的文学风格，也培养了他对古典悲剧形式的深刻理解。
points.descriptionEn: In 1649, Racine was sent to a Jesuit school in Pau for education. There, he received rigorous classical education, studying Latin, Greek, and classical literature. This educational experience laid a solid foundation for his later dramatic works. In 1655, he transferred to a Jesuit school in Rouen, continuing his studies. During his time in Rouen, he began writing poetry and demonstrated exceptional literary talent. This period of education not only shaped his literary style but also fostered his deep understanding of classical tragic forms.

points.title: 戏剧崛起
points.description: 1664年，拉辛来到巴黎，开始他的戏剧创作生涯。他的第一部悲剧《德巴依特》在黎塞留学院的庇护下上演，获得了初步成功。随后，他创作了一系列经典悲剧作品，包括《亚历山大》(1665)、《安德洛玛克》(1667)、《布里塔尼居斯》(1669)和《贝蕾妮丝》(1670)。这些作品以其精湛的语言艺术、深刻的心理刻画和对古典悲剧形式的完美运用而闻名。1673年，拉辛当选为法兰西学院院士，确立了他在法国文学界的崇高地位。这一时期是他创作的黄金时代，作品不仅在巴黎舞台上大获成功，也深刻影响了法国戏剧的发展方向。
points.descriptionEn: In 1664, Racine arrived in Paris and began his dramatic career. His first tragedy, 'La Thébaïde,' was performed under the patronage of the Académie Française and achieved initial success. Subsequently, he created a series of classic tragic works including 'Alexandre' (1665), 'Andromaque' (1667), 'Britannicus' (1669), and 'Bérénice' (1670). These works were renowned for their exquisite language art, profound psychological characterization, and perfect mastery of classical tragic forms. In 1673, Racine was elected to the Académie Française, establishing his esteemed position in French literary circles. This period marked his golden age of creation, with his works not only achieving great success on Parisian stages but also profoundly influencing the direction of French theatrical development.

points.title: 宫廷荣耀
points.description: 1673年当选法兰西学院院士后，拉辛获得了路易十四的赏识，成为宫廷诗人。他开始在凡尔赛宫为国王创作戏剧，包括《巴雅泽》(1672)、《米特里达特》(1673)、《伊菲革涅亚》(1674)和《费德尔》(1677)。这些作品不仅为他带来了巨大的声誉和丰厚的收入，也使他成为法国古典主义戏剧的代表人物。然而，与同时期的莫里哀相比，拉辛的戏剧风格更为严肃和深刻，专注于人物内心世界的探索和命运的悲剧性。这一时期，拉辛的戏剧创作达到了顶峰，他的作品成为法国宫廷文化的重要组成部分，也深刻影响了欧洲戏剧的发展。
points.descriptionEn: After being elected to the Académie Française in 1673, Racine gained the favor of Louis XIV and became a court poet. He began writing plays for the king at the Palace of Versailles, including 'Bajazet' (1672), 'Mithridate' (1673), 'Iphigénie' (1674), and 'Phèdre' (1677). These works not only brought him great fame and substantial income but also established him as a representative figure of French classical theater. Compared to his contemporary Molière, Racine's dramatic style was more serious and profound, focusing on the exploration of characters' inner worlds and the tragic nature of fate. During this period, Racine's dramatic creation reached its zenith, his works becoming an important part of French court culture and profoundly influencing the development of European theater.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 1689年，拉辛创作了他最后一部悲剧《爱斯苔尔》，这部作品以圣经故事为背景，展现了他对宗教主题的深入探索。此后，他逐渐减少戏剧创作，转而担任路易十四的历史学家，记录国王的丰功伟绩。1699年4月21日，拉辛在巴黎因肝癌去世，享年59岁。他的晚年虽然远离戏剧舞台，但他的作品已经确立了他在法国文学史上的不朽地位。拉辛的戏剧以其精湛的语言艺术、深刻的心理刻画和对人类命运的深刻思考而闻名，对后世戏剧创作产生了深远影响，成为法国古典主义文学的巅峰代表。
points.descriptionEn: In 1689, Racine wrote his last tragedy, 'Esther,' which was based on biblical stories and demonstrated his deep exploration of religious themes. Afterward, he gradually reduced his dramatic output and instead served as Louis XIV's historian, documenting the king's great achievements. On April 21, 1699, Racine died in Paris from liver cancer at the age of 59. Although his later years were away from the theatrical stage, his works had already established his immortal position in French literary history. Racine's dramas are renowned for their exquisite language art, profound psychological characterization, and deep reflection on human destiny, exerting a far-reaching influence on later dramatic creation and becoming the pinnacle of French classical literature.

supporter.zh: 拉辛被誉为法国古典主义戏剧的巅峰代表，其作品以精湛的语言艺术和深刻的心理刻画著称。支持者认为他通过悲剧形式揭示了人类情感的复杂性和命运的不可抗拒性，创造了永恒的艺术价值。他的戏剧结构严谨，语言优美，人物形象立体，对后世戏剧发展产生了深远影响。拉辛的作品不仅代表了法国古典主义文学的最高成就，也成为世界戏剧宝库中的经典之作。
supporter.en: Racine is hailed as the pinnacle of French classical theater, celebrated for his exquisite language art and profound psychological characterization. Supporters argue that through tragedy, he revealed the complexity of human emotions and the inevitability of fate, creating eternal artistic value. His plays feature rigorous structure, beautiful language, and three-dimensional characters, exerting a profound influence on the development of later drama. Racine's works not only represent the highest achievement of French classical literature but have also become classics in the world's theatrical treasure trove.

critic.zh: 批评者认为拉辛的戏剧过于注重形式和语言的完美，而忽视了内容的创新和思想的深度。他的作品往往遵循严格的古典悲剧规则，缺乏莫里哀那样的社会批判性和喜剧元素。此外，拉辛后期转向宗教题材被一些评论家视为创作力的衰退。还有人批评他过于迎合宫廷贵族的品味，缺乏对普通民众生活的关注，这使得他的作品虽然艺术价值高，但社会意义相对有限。
critic.en: Critics argue that Racine's plays过分注重 formal and linguistic perfection at the expense of content innovation and depth of thought. His works often adhere strictly to classical tragic rules, lacking the social critique and comic elements found in Molière's plays. Additionally, some critics view his shift to religious themes in later works as a decline in creative vitality. Others criticize his excessive catering to the tastes of court aristocracy, showing little concern for the lives of ordinary people, which makes his works artistically valuable but socially limited in significance.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，拉辛被公认为法国古典主义戏剧的三大巨匠之一（与高乃依、莫里齐齐名）。他的作品以其对人类心理的深刻洞察和对悲剧形式的完美运用而闻名。在流行文化中，拉辛的名字已成为戏剧艺术的象征，他的台词被广泛引用，人物形象成为文学研究的经典案例。现代戏剧导演经常重新诠释他的作品，赋予其当代意义。拉辛的戏剧不仅影响了欧洲戏剧发展，也对世界文学产生了深远影响，成为人类共同文化遗产的重要组成部分。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Racine is widely recognized as one of the three great masters of French classical theater (alongside Corneille and Molière). His works are renowned for their profound insight into human psychology and perfect mastery of tragic form. In popular culture, Racine's name has become synonymous with theatrical art, with his lines widely quoted and characters serving as classic cases in literary studies. Modern theater directors frequently reinterpret his works, endowing them with contemporary significance. Racine's dramas have not only influenced European theater but also had a profound impact on world literature, becoming an important part of humanity's shared cultural heritage.

self.zh: 爱情是唯一能让我们忘记自己的东西，也是唯一能让我们想起自己的东西。
self.en: Love is the only thing that can make us forget ourselves, and the only thing that can remind us of ourselves.

others.zh: 拉辛是法国最伟大的悲剧诗人，他的作品以其纯粹的美和深刻的情感而超越时代。
others.en: Racine is France's greatest tragic poet, whose works transcend time through their pure beauty and profound emotion.
